title: Editing or canceling a scheduled payment
summary: Explains how to edit or cancel a scheduled payment: you can change future amount, next occurrence date, or cadence. Editing is locked within 13 hours of the upcoming occurrence; changes after that apply later. Cancellation stops future occurrences, but a very-near next occurrence may still process.
